tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground. Every screen and page sits on it. In bitmaps for RGB565 screens (the iPod) use paper-bitmap so images and background match exactly.

tokens.name: paper-bitmap
tokens.usage: paper as it actually shows on a 16-bit (RGB565) screen. Use it for pixels inside images; never as a CSS background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, the brackets of the mark, rules that carry meaning. Pure black, never a dark grey.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The dot in the mark, and nothing else by default. One orange thing per screen. Never text, never a background.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the unfilled part of a progress line, corner ticks, quiet dividers. Decoration only; never text.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Secondary counters (1/1). 3.9:1 on paper: below 4.5:1, so only for non-essential small text or text 24px and up. Prefer ink.

families.sans: "TeX Gyre Heros", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one main thing on a screen (song name, page title). Lowercase. One per screen.

styles.name: info
styles.usage: Every line under the title: one size, one weight, one colour (ink), set tight at 20px.

styles.name: menu
styles.usage: Menu and navigation items, in [brackets], lowercase, words joined with _.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small subtext: labels in "quotes", times, counters. Small on purpose.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top inset of the mark (y = 8 on a 320x240 screen).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The margin. Left edge of the single text column; right edge of the mark.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Line pitch of the info lines under a title.

tokens.name: space-44
tokens.usage: Where content starts below the header row (mark + barcode).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything is square: rules, blocks, frames.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only the dot of the mark.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Rules and progress lines are 1px. No heavier lines.
